title: CCB
description: Introduction to digital CCB[br]Christian Community Bible（CCB）was proved and published by the Bishop Conference of the Philippines in 1988. Being one of the most distributed editions of La Biblia Latinamericana which is the origin of this series, CCB has helped numerous readers in the past thirty six years to understand the Word of God. Bible is the Word of God. By reading and mediating on it, your faith will be cherished and your relationship with our Lord Jesus deepened. You can also have an encounter with God by reading the Bible, if you search Him with perseverance, a humble heart and an ardent love for kindness, justice and mercy. Don’t give up if you cannot understand at the beginning, but ask in prayer and you will receive light. Another condition to grasp the teaching of God is that you search for it together with your community. Biblical texts were born within the Jewish and Christian communities and its strength, energy, illumination and power will come alive when you share it with your brothers and sisters within the Christian community, as its title indicates. “Your word is a lamp to my feet, a light for my path. ”(Palms 119:105)[br]CCB’s language style is colloquial and easy to understand. This is because the entire series aims at transmitting the divine message and revelation to simple people who desire to listen and live to the Words of God. “Father, Lord of Heaven and Earth, for you have hidden these things from the wise and learned and made them known to littles.(Lk10,21)[br]At year 2013 we published a revised edition which biblical scholars, linguist, editors and copy editors contributed their labor and suggestion into it. It has brought the text closer to its original language. All biblical cross references were verified. The spelling of those words which are in capital letter now is consistent. Some new changes in the translation of four Gospels texts appeared here. The version references are cited in the commentary when texts are quoted for easy reference. Also thanks to the Grail Society who allows us to use their commentaries. We wish that you benefit from their revision work. It makes the CCB reading experience all the more fruitful and spiritual. Happy reading!
